description: List YOUR completed sandbox runs (most recent first) so you can recover a runId and publish_run it later — even across sessions, after losing the runId run_recipe returned inline. Read scope. Returns each run's runId, mode, prompt + output preview, image_url, source recipe, and created_at. Only completed runs are listed (pending/failed runs have no output and aren't publishable).
name: list_runs

outputSchema.description: Your completed sandbox runs, most recent first.

image_url.description: The rendered image, for image runs

output_preview.description: Output preview for text runs; null for image runs

publishable_via.description: The exact next call to ship this run

published_post_id.description: Null when the run has never been published (a run publishes at most once)

runId.description: Pass to publish_run to ship this run

source_post_id.description: The post this run was grounded against, if any

title: List your sandbox runs
